# The linked project a v3 evolution transaction binds by roster

Four leaves are LISTED in `../rosters/complete.json`: this file, `nested/data.json`,
`run.sh` (executable), and `symlink-to-readme.md` (a symlink). `unlisted.txt` is
committed beside them and is deliberately absent from every roster: a caller
omitting a tracked path is making a narrower explicit claim, and the identity of
this project under that claim must not move when an unlisted leaf changes.
